book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 设 $x_{i} \in \mathbf{R} (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n, n \geqslant 3)$. 令 $p = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_{i}$, $q = \sum_{1 \leqslant i < j \leqslant n} x_{i}x_{j}$, 求证: $\frac{n-1}{n} p^{2} - 2q \geqslant 0$; $\left|x_{i} - \frac{p}{n}\right| \leqslant \frac{n-1}{n} \sqrt{p^{2} - \frac{2n}{n-1}q}$, $i = 1, 2, \cdots, n$.
original_text_md: 设 $x_{i} \in \mathbf{R} (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n, n \geqslant 3)$. 令 $p = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_{i}$, $q = \sum_{1 \leqslant i < j \leqslant n} x_{i}x_{j}$, 求证: $\frac{n-1}{n} p^{2} - 2q \geqslant 0$; $\left|x_{i} - \frac{p}{n}\right| \leqslant \frac{n-1}{n} \sqrt{p^{2} - \frac{2n}{n-1}q}$, $i = 1, 2, \cdots, n$.
